component.name: Hot Edge
Borda ativa
component.summary: Push the pointer into the edge of the screen to open the overview
Empurre o cursor contra a borda da tela para abrir a visão geral

description.p: GNOME's Hot Edge extension for COSMIC: a hot edge along the bottom of the screen that opens the workspaces overview when the pointer is pushed into it, like an auto-hiding dock without changing the desktop. Its settings are the extension's: activation pressure, edge size, not activating while a mouse button is held or a fullscreen window is focused, only on the primary monitor, and the ripple animation. On COSMIC the edge and what it opens can be chosen too.
